name: the field tag -- a pair form's optional mark, PERSONAL reaching it, SAFEGUARDS on the ask and the voice (ZTAG, the author's yes of 2026-11-02)
comment: Written BEFORE any court code (the W discipline). A pair form may carry a third, optional seat typed by a MENU -- the mark -- and a sentence writes it after the value: `member: text personal`. The CONSTITUTION's PERSONAL may then name the mark seat by a three-part path, decl.seat.mark: every field a sentence marks personal or confidential is a personal datum at the record level. The weaves judge the two paths records take out of the world: the ask (W4.2) needs a SAFEGUARD -- consent, or anonymisation, which the court applies -- and the voice (W4.4) needs redaction, which the court applies; at constitutional a missing safeguard refuses, at governance it warns, at advisory it notes. The safeguard words are stzFieldTags' (D35); the model path stays stzlib's and HaroBase's. The regime is Niger Law 2017-28 throughout, the circle's own. v0.27 refuses nothing v0.26 accepted (A4 is v0.26's A1 unchanged; A5 shows the tag seat alone governs nothing). Corrected once after the court spoke (HF-131): R1 was written under ARTICLES [explainability] with no NARRATE, so Art. 1 refused it before the weave could -- the fixture's own declaration broke another article; it stands under trust_hierarchy, the one article a bare world satisfies, and the refusal it asks for is unchanged.

accepts.name: Z with the tag on its field form, PERSONAL reaching the mark, and both safeguards: consent on the ask, redaction on the voice
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.27", GRAMMAR "0.27", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, not, cmp, contains, add, sub, mul, div, round, neg], OPERANDS [number, text, flag, ref, agg], AGGREGATES [sum, count], ABSENT missing, DIVISION calm, EQUALITY value) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU actors AS (WORDS [collector, treasurer, system, member, auditor]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU formats AS (WORDS [json, csv]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU holders AS (WORDS [the_commons, the_cooperative, the_bank]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU tags AS (WORDS [plain, personal, confidential]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM field AS (SEATS [name: name, type: name, tag: tags?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION enum AS (VERB "ENUM", SEATS [words: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION entity AS (VERB "ENTITY", SEATS [fields: [field]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION norm AS (VERB "NORM", SEATS [rule: zexpr, message: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [flow: flow, order: number, actor: actors]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION landing_zone AS (VERB "LANDING_ZONE", SEATS [format: formats, into: flow, held_by: holders]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE ASK questions AS (FROM [flow], WHERE zexpr, CLAUSES [where, order, limit]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD z AS (PUBLISH [flow: flow, entity: entity, norm: norm, landing_zone: zone]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The ZQL verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE z AS (POINTS [landing_zone.held_by: policy], FLOOR [landing_zone.held_by: trusted]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE telling AS (SAYS [enum: "{name} is one of {words}.", entity: "{name} is a record of {fields}.", norm: "{name} holds {rule}.", flow: "{name} is a flow.", step: "{name} is step {order} of {flow}.", landing_zone: "{name} is held by {held_by}."], TELLS [ask: "Asking {from}: {question}", answer: "The answer is {count} row(s): {rows}"], REFUSES "I stopped: {message} ({code})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION z_charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability, reversibility, visible_state, predictable_authority, organizational_sovereignty, trust_hierarchy], ZONE landing_zone, SOVEREIGN held_by, MOVEMENT into, WEAVES [sovereignty: constitutional, privacy: constitutional], REGIME niger_2017_28, PERSONAL [entity.fields.tag], SAFEGUARDS [ask: consent, voice: redaction]) RATIONALE "the members consented to the circle's ledger; what the voice tells leaves redacted"
